CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ban_community_member(p_user uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_scope text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'pro'::public.app_role) then
    raise exception 'not_allowed';
  end if;

  if public.has_role(p_user, 'pro'::public.app_role) then
    raise exception 'cannot_ban';
  end if;

  if p_scope not in ('all', 'groups') then
    raise exception 'invalid_scope';
  end if;

  insert into public.community_bans (user_id, reason, banned_by, scope)
  values (p_user, left(p_reason, 300), auth.uid(), p_scope)
  on conflict (user_id) do update
    set reason = excluded.reason,
        banned_by = excluded.banned_by,
        scope = excluded.scope,
        created_at = now();

  update public.feed_groups set owner_id = auth.uid() where owner_id = p_user;

  insert into public.feed_group_members (group_id, user_id, role, status)
  select g.id, auth.uid(), 'owner', 'active'
  from public.feed_groups g
  where g.owner_id = auth.uid()
  on conflict (group_id, user_id) do update set role = 'owner', status = 'active';

  update public.feed_group_members
  set status = 'banned', role = 'member'
  where user_id = p_user;

  perform public.notify_user(
    p_user, 'moderation',
    case when p_scope = 'groups' then 'Vous avez été banni(e) de tous les groupes' else 'Vous avez été banni(e) de la communauté' end,
    case when p_scope = 'groups'
      then 'Vous avez été banni(e) de tous les groupes car une règle de la charte de respect n''a pas été respectée.'
      else 'Vous avez été banni(e) de la communauté car une règle de la charte de respect n''a pas été respectée. Vous pouvez encore lire le feed.'
    end
      || case when coalesce(btrim(p_reason), '') <> '' then ' Motif : ' || left(btrim(p_reason), 300) || '.' else '' end
      || ' Vous pouvez envoyer un message au coach pour vous expliquer et demander votre réintégration.',
    '/groups'
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_participate_in_community(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.is_adult(p_user)
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.profiles pr
      where pr.id = p_user
        and (
          pr.role = 'pro'
          or pr.role = 'patient'
          or (
            pr.role = 'subscriber'
            and pr.plan in ('basic', 'premium')
          )
        )
    )
    and coalesce(public.subscriber_access_state(p_user), 'unrestricted') <> 'suspended'
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from public.community_bans b
      where b.user_id = p_user
        and b.scope = 'all'
    )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_read_feed_group(p_group uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select auth.uid() is not null and (
    public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'pro'::public.app_role)
    or (
      public.is_group_member(auth.uid(), p_group)
      and public.can_participate_in_community(auth.uid())
      and public.has_accepted_charter(auth.uid())
      and not public.is_banned_from_groups(auth.uid())
      and not public.is_banned_from_group(auth.uid(), p_group)
    )
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.community_badges(p_users uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, badge text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p.id,
    case
      when p.role = 'pro' then 'coach'
      when p.role = 'patient' then
        case when public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'pro'::public.app_role) then 'patient' else 'premium' end
      when p.role = 'subscriber' and p.plan::text in ('premium', 'visio') then 'premium'
      else 'basic'
    end
  from public.profiles p
  where auth.uid() is not null
    and p.id = any(p_users)
    and (
      p.role = 'pro'
      or exists (select 1 from public.community_profiles cp where cp.user_id = p.id)
    )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.feed_like_counts()
 RETURNS TABLE(content_id uuid, likes bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select i.content_id, count(*)::bigint
  from public.feed_interactions i
  join public.feed_content c on c.id = i.content_id and c.is_published = true
  where i.liked = true
    and (
      c.group_id is null
      or public.is_group_member(auth.uid(), c.group_id)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'pro'::public.app_role)
    )
  group by i.content_id
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_accepted_charter(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select public.has_role(p_user, 'pro'::public.app_role)
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.community_charter_acceptances a
      where a.user_id = p_user and a.version >= 1
    )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_banned_from_group(p_user uuid, p_group uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.feed_group_bans b
    where b.group_id = p_group and b.user_id = p_user
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_banned_from_groups(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.community_bans b where b.user_id = p_user)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_group_member(p_user uuid, p_group uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.feed_group_members m
    where m.group_id = p_group and m.user_id = p_user and m.status = 'active'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_group_owner(p_user uuid, p_group uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.feed_groups g
    where g.id = p_group and g.owner_id = p_user
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_group_invitations()
 RETURNS TABLE(group_id uuid, group_name text, description text, invited_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select m.group_id, g.name, g.description, m.created_at
  from public.feed_group_members m
  join public.feed_groups g on g.id = m.group_id
  where m.user_id = auth.uid() and m.status = 'invited'
  order by m.created_at desc
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.preview_group_by_code(p_code text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, name text, description text, members bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select g.id, g.name, g.description,
    (select count(*) from public.feed_group_members m where m.group_id = g.id and m.status = 'active')
  from public.feed_groups g
  where g.invite_code = p_code and g.invite_enabled = true
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles
    where id = _user_id and role = _role
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_adult(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce((
    select case
      when pr.role = 'pro' then true
      when pr.role = 'patient' then exists (
        select 1 from public.patients pa
        where pa.user_id = pr.id
          and coalesce(pa.is_minor, false) = false
          and (
            (pa.birth_date is not null and pa.birth_date <= (current_date - interval '18 years'))
            or (pa.age is not null and pa.age >= 18)
          )
      )
      else (pr.age is not null and pr.age >= 18)
    end
    from public.profiles pr
    where pr.id = p_user
  ), false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_user(p_user uuid, p_type text, p_title text, p_body text, p_link text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  insert into public.scheduled_notifications
    (user_id, channel, type, title, body, link, payload, scheduled_for, sent_at)
  values (p_user, 'in_app', p_type, p_title, p_body, p_link, '{}'::jsonb, now(), now())
$function$
